claim_boundary: Cycle C005 adds ten hypotheses that survived the recorded immediate attacks. None is a proof, novelty claim, probability assessment, or evidence for P=NP or P!=NP.

hypotheses.title: Optimal Dag-like Cutting Planes Lower Bound for Bit-PHP Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exists a constant c>0 such that every unrestricted dag-like Cutting Planes refutation of the standard concise bit pigeonhole principle CNF BPHP_n has size at least 2^(c n), where proof size counts all written inequalities and coefficient bit lengths.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This would strengthen the current subexponential-in-n exponent lower bound for general dag-like Cutting Planes on BPHP_n to an optimal exponential lower bound and would sharply constrain branch-and-cut proof search.
falsification_conditions: A family of unrestricted dag-like Cutting Planes refutations of BPHP_n of size 2^o(n).
A theorem giving subexponential-size Cutting Planes proofs for the exact standard BPHP_n encoding and size measure.
attack_surface: possible counting proofs exploiting concise encodings
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The 2025 theorem proves an exponential lower bound with exponent Omega(n^(1/4)), not the linear exponent asserted here. H020 is a sharpening frontier, not a new theorem.

hypotheses.title: Unrestricted Stabbing Planes Superpolynomial Size Lower-Bound Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exists an explicit polynomial-time constructible family of unsatisfiable CNF formulas F_n of size poly(n) such that every unrestricted Stabbing Planes refutation of F_n, with coefficient bit length included in proof size, has size n^omega(1).
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This would give a superpolynomial size lower bound for the unrestricted branch-and-cut proof model rather than only bounded-coefficient, depth, tree-like, or near-linear regimes.
falsification_conditions: A polynomial p such that every unsatisfiable CNF has an unrestricted Stabbing Planes refutation of size at most p(n).
Polynomial-size unrestricted Stabbing Planes refutations for every explicit candidate family covered by a sharpened descendant.
attack_surface: short Stabbing Planes refutations of Tseitin systems
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Known cited results establish lower bounds for bounded coefficients, depth, or restricted families, and also show short proofs for important parity principles. They do not settle unrestricted size.

hypotheses.title: Polynomial Cutting Planes Simulation of Unrestricted Stabbing Planes Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exists a polynomial p such that every unrestricted Stabbing Planes refutation of a CNF F having s nodes and total coefficient bit complexity L can be translated uniformly into a Cutting Planes refutation of F of size at most p(|F|,s,L).
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Cutting Planes would polynomially simulate unrestricted branch-and-cut reasoning, transferring general Cutting Planes lower bounds to Stabbing Planes and ruling out H023.
falsification_conditions: An explicit CNF family with polynomial-size Stabbing Planes proofs but superpolynomial Cutting Planes proofs under compatible bit-size measures.
A structural invariant preserved by polynomial-size Cutting Planes proofs and violated by a polynomial-size unrestricted Stabbing Planes family.
attack_surface: quasipolynomial Cutting Planes simulations for finite-field systems
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The known translation covers bounded-coefficient Stabbing Planes. H022 quantifies over unrestricted proofs while explicitly charging coefficient bit length.

hypotheses.title: Stabbing Planes versus Cutting Planes Superpolynomial Separation Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exists an explicit polynomial-time constructible CNF family F_n with polynomial-size unrestricted Stabbing Planes refutations but requiring n^omega(1) size Cutting Planes refutations, with coefficient bit lengths charged in both systems.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This would show that unrestricted branch-and-cut reasoning is genuinely stronger than Cutting Planes and would refute H022.
falsification_conditions: A polynomial simulation of unrestricted Stabbing Planes by Cutting Planes as stated in H022.
A theorem showing that every polynomial-size Stabbing Planes family has polynomial-size Cutting Planes refutations under the same encoding and bit-size convention.
attack_surface: short Stabbing Planes proofs of Tseitin formulas
quasipolynomial Cutting Planes proofs for finite-field systems
candidate formulas requiring unbounded geometric branching
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Existing Tseitin examples give short Stabbing Planes proofs but also quasipolynomial Cutting Planes proofs, so they do not establish the required superpolynomial separation.

hypotheses.title: Recursive Fan-in-Two Extension Polynomial Calculus Lower-Bound Conjecture over GF(2)
hypotheses.statement: There exists an explicit polynomial-time constructible family of unsatisfiable CNF formulas F_n such that every Polynomial Calculus refutation over GF(2) using recursively composed fan-in-two extension definitions y=uv, y=u+v, and y=1-u has total explicit symbol size n^omega(1), even when extension variables may depend globally on the original variables through earlier extensions.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This would close the principal extension-support escape left open by current finite-field lower bounds and would destroy the unsatisfiable-case proof promise inside H010.
falsification_conditions: A polynomial p such that every unsatisfiable CNF has a refutation in the exact recursive extension system of size at most p(n).
Polynomial-size refutations in the exact system for every explicit candidate hard family selected by a descendant.
attack_surface: explicit sparse representation and symbol accounting
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Existing theorems cover bounded dependence, arity-count tradeoffs, or different fields and size measures. No lower bound for the exact recursively global GF(2) system is claimed.

hypotheses.title: Polynomial Boundedness of Recursive Fan-in-Two Extension Polynomial Calculus over GF(2)
hypotheses.statement: There exists a polynomial p such that every unsatisfiable CNF F has a Polynomial Calculus refutation over GF(2) of explicit symbol size at most p(|F|) using recursively composed fan-in-two extension definitions y=uv, y=u+v, and y=1-u, with every proof line represented explicitly as a sparse multilinear polynomial.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: The stated Cook-Reckhow-style algebraic system would be polynomially bounded and H024 would be false. This would address proof existence only, not deterministic proof search for satisfiable and unsatisfiable inputs.
falsification_conditions: An explicit CNF family requiring n^omega(1) refutation size in the exact recursive extension system.
A lower-bound theorem extending finite-field bounded-support results to unrestricted recursive support.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: H025 is intentionally incompatible with H024. Current lower bounds do not cover its unrestricted recursive-support model, and it does not imply that proofs can be found efficiently.

hypotheses.title: Hard-DNF Tautology Conjecture for AC0[p]-Frege
hypotheses.statement: For at least one fixed prime p, the explicit DNF family constructed in the 2026 AC0[p]-Frege metacomplexity result is a family of propositional tautologies for infinitely many input lengths.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: Combined with the proved lower bound in the cited work, this would yield an explicit infinite family of tautologies with no polynomial-size AC0[p]-Frege proofs.
falsification_conditions: A falsifying Boolean assignment for every sufficiently large member of the exact DNF family.
A theorem showing that the constructed DNF is not a tautology for all but finitely many lengths.
hypotheses.claim_boundary: The cited theorem proves proof hardness conditional on tautologicity and gives evidence for tautologicity; it does not prove the statement registered here.

hypotheses.title: Local Definitional Separator Obstruction Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For every finite bounded-radius, constant-certificate, fan-in-two definitional CNF rewrite grammar of the exact type permitted by H009, there exists an explicit polynomial-time constructible expander-based CNF family on which the canonical rewrite run either exceeds polynomial size or steps, violates equivalence or witness recovery, or terminates with primal treewidth omega(log n).
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: H009 would be destroyed by a uniform structural obstruction theorem while leaving open unrelated routes to P=NP.
falsification_conditions: A concrete H009 grammar satisfying all size, correctness, recovery, and O(log n) treewidth promises on every CNF.
A theorem constructing such a universal grammar within the exact H009 model.
attack_surface: computational universality of finite local rewrite systems
separator and minor measures under definitional extensions
hypotheses.claim_boundary: No preserved separator invariant for all H009 rules is known. H027 is an adversarial conjecture aimed at an existing JANUS mechanism, not evidence that P differs from NP.

hypotheses.title: Parity-Core Residual Width Obstruction Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: For every fixed compiler in the exact H017 model, there exists an explicit polynomial-size CNF family whose certified affine subsystem can be eliminated by Gaussian elimination but whose remaining non-affine residual forces either superpolynomial intermediate size or primal treewidth omega(log n).
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: This would destroy H017 by showing that explicit parity extraction cannot universally collapse the non-affine remainder.
falsification_conditions: A concrete H017 compiler meeting its polynomial resource and O(log n) width guarantees on every CNF.
A theorem that every CNF admits the required parity-core decomposition and locally certified low-width residual.
attack_surface: pure Tseitin systems with short Gaussian reasoning
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Pure parity formulas cannot witness H028 because H017 handles explicit affine structure. The required hard family must retain provably complex non-affine residual structure.

hypotheses.title: Recursive Extension Support-Compression Conjecture
hypotheses.statement: There exist constants epsilon, delta, and c greater than zero such that every polynomial-size constant-degree GF(2) Polynomial Calculus refutation using recursively composed fan-in-two extension variables can be transformed with polynomial blow-up into a refutation using at most n^(1+epsilon(1-delta)) extension variables, each depending on at most n^(1-epsilon) original variables and represented by size at most n^c.
hypotheses.consequence_if_true: For explicit AC0[2] families covered by existing arity-count tradeoff lower bounds, the normalization would rule out polynomial-size recursive-extension refutations and would provide a route to destroy H010 and prove a restricted form of H024.
falsification_conditions: A polynomial-size recursive-extension refutation family for which every equivalent proof in the bounded-support tradeoff regime has superpolynomial size.
A structural theorem showing that globally supported recursive extensions cannot in general be normalized to the stated resource regime.
attack_surface: balanced fan-in-two circuits with global semantic support
hypotheses.claim_boundary: Recursive fan-in-two syntax does not imply bounded semantic support. The conjecture asserts a nontrivial proof normalization, not a simple flattening of extension definitions.
